match: fontFamily — wireframe ""SF Pro Text", system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif" vs app ""SF Pro Text", system-ui, -apple-system, "system-ui", sans-serif"
reason: 2026-09-15: first run of this gate on Windows (docs/windows-port.md) — the app's own font-family declaration is unchanged (it always lists BlinkMacSystemFont after -apple-system as a macOS-only fallback keyword); Chromium's getComputedStyle() on Windows drops BlinkMacSystemFont (an identifier that keyword means nothing on that platform) and substitutes the generic 'system-ui' token instead, purely in how the computed style STRING is reported — confirmed via chromasmith-22.html's design/tokens.json, not touched this session. The wireframe reference itself was captured on macOS Chromium. Same root cause repeats per-zone (this entry, and one per zone below) because the check is zone-scoped; the actual rendered font (San Francisco / the OS UI font) is identical either way.
